title: Why It Will Not Fly
lines: Tim is shy, but he likes to fly kites.
It is dry and sunny by the pond.
Tim runs with his kite, but it drops.
He runs and runs. It will not fly.
Tim sits in the grass and asks why.
Then he thinks of the rags in his bag.
Tim pins the rags on the kite tip.
He runs on the dry path and lets go.
The kite lifts up into the sky.
Mom grins. Tim is not shy at all.
He will try that trick next time.

questions.ask: What happened the first time Tim ran with his kite?
questions.listenFor: It dropped and would not fly. Stated in the story - point them at that line rather than saying it for them.

questions.ask: What did Tim pin on the kite tip?
questions.listenFor: The rags from his bag. If they say "a kite tail," that is the same idea, but ask them to find the word the story used.

questions.ask: Do you think Tim will fly the kite again? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. Listen for a reason - the rag trick worked, or he likes kites.
